items.name: SSL 1 Jönköping 2017

venue.name: [Kulturhuset Jönköping] (http://kulturhusetjonkoping.se/)
venue.details: The room is called Kulturvinden, located in the attic.

items.information: The competition is a part of the Swedish Speedcubing League 2017. This is the first out of four competitions, followed by a final competiton later this year. The entry fee is set to 100 SEK and must be payed in advance by swedish competitors. Foreigners may pay at the competition venue. A competitor limit has been set to 70 competitors due to venue constraints. More information and payment details can be found on the competition website.

items.name: Peterborough Open 2017
items.information: You must pay the entry fee online via the button on the [UKCA site](http://www.ukca.org/competitions/upcoming-competitions/peterborough-open-2017/registration) before your registration is approved. This fee is non-refundable, as it represents a commitment to attending the competition. There is a competitor limit of 80. Registration opens at 19:00 on Thursday 12th January and will close at midnight on Sunday 19th February.

items.information: Registration fee: $20 per competitor. Registration must be paid online via Paypal. There is no at-the-door registration. There will be a competitor limit of 125.

items.name: Keep Portland Weird 2017
items.information: Registration includes free pizza for competitors after the awards ceremony.  There is a 110 competitor limit for this competition.

items.name: KCubing Winter 2017

venue.name: First Raytown Baptist
venue.details: Enter in the cafe, turn right at the Gym, and the room will be on your left.

items.information:
Registration Info

Registration is $12 for each competitor (includes 3x3) and an additional $2 for each event other than 3x3. 

Late fee will be charged starting Feburary 22nd. Late fee will be $15 for each competitor (includes 3x3) and $4 for each event after that. When you sign up, it will put you on the waiting list. If there are not 85 competitors registered, I'm awaiting payment via paypal (see the registration tab for more info) 

Spectators get in free. No walk in competitors.

**lunch**
Pizza will be served for $2 a slice.


Thank you to TheCubicle.us for sponsoring this competition. Consider checking them out next time you want to order a puzzle.

[Directions](https://www.google.com/maps/dir//10500+E+State+Rte+350,+Raytown,+MO+64138/@38.9849374,-94.4588741,17z/data=!4m13!1m4!3m3!1s0x87c0e161caee72d1:0x83aaab1c75d39d09!2s10500+E+State+Rte+350,+Raytown,+MO+64138!3b1!4m7!1m0!1m5!1m1!1s0x87c0e161caee72d1:0x83aaab1c75d39d09!2m2!1d-94.4566854!2d38.9849374) on google maps.

items.name: Bluegrass Spring 2017

venue.details: There are parking lots in front and back of the school.  Please use the Front Entrance.

items.information:
There is a $25 flat fee for this competition. Profits will go to the University of Kentucky's Engineers Without Borders program. 
There is a limit of 80 competitors for this competition.
Spectators are welcome and do not need to register or pay. 
Visit the competition website for more details.
